catalogue.versionDifference: PostgreSQL 17 GRANT ALL includes MAINTAIN (ACL m). The local PostgreSQL 16 reference has arwdDxt; hosted has arwdDxtm only for postgres and for service_role on public.recruitment_erasure_jobs. No anon/authenticated MAINTAIN and no service_role access to private tables/schema. All other catalogue entries and tested privilege booleans match.
